title: Reviewing strata management law after the Wang Fuk Court fire
asked: Mr Fadli Fawzi asked whether the Government's review of the Building Maintenance and Strata Management Act 2004 will incorporate learnings from the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po, Hong Kong, and if not, why not.
response: Ms Sun Xueling said Hong Kong authorities are still investigating the Wang Fuk Court fire, but the Government has been reviewing early observations. Where relevant, the Ministry of National Development will incorporate findings into its legislative and policy framework, including the Building (Strata Management) Act. In a supplementary reply, she said the review will look at the powers of the Management Corporation Strata Title, with more information to come.
